scope: Screen-only player. Model verifies turn, labels and card ranks. Fixed green-table pixel adapter verifies enabled state for button-only actions. Local OCR reads layout and visible history.
fixture_note: Manually reviewed crops from two development runs; repeated button appearances are not independent samples.
tests: 118 full-suite tests passed; after adding one integration case, all 3 button tests passed. 7 server tests passed.
limitations: Only current green-table palette, fixed 1440x1600 CSS and 2x screenshots supported.
Thresholds are profile-specific pixel rules, not model confidence scores.
One held-out seed is not a reliability or win-rate estimate.
Play submit button may be disabled before card selection; enabled-state check here covers button-only actions. Existing fresh-frame and post-action checks remain.
